verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs show a risk workflow exists: the SOC 2 Launchpad has you "action policies, risks, and evidence" (sprinto-docs-6, sprinto-docs-19), and there is a Continuous Risk Monitoring page (sprinto-docs-12). The detailed scoring, owner and remediation-task evidence belongs to the AI Systems module (sprinto-docs-41, sprinto-docs-46, sprinto-docs-31, sprinto-docs-44), not a documented general risk register. missing for 10: explicit general risk register with scoring methodology, treatment plans, documented owner assignment for organizational risks, periodic review cycles, risk-to-control mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
